senses.gloss: † मुण् मुण्, i. 6, Par. To promise.
† मुण्ठ् मुण्ठ्, i. 1, Ātm. To run away (or to protect).

† 1. मुण्ड् मुण्ड्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To shave.
 2. To grind or pound; see 2. मुट्.

† 2. मुण्ड् मुण्ड्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To be pure.
 2. To sink.

मुण्ड मुण्ड (probably a form of a noun derived from मृद्, based on the original form मर्द्),
 I. adj.
 1. Shaved, bald, having no hair on the head, Man. 2, 219.
 2. Low, mean.
 II. m. and n.
 1. The head, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 6; Hit. iii. d. 89.
 2. The forehead.
 III. m.
 1. A bald-pate.
 2. A barber.
 3. Rāhu.
 4. The name of a Daitya.
 IV. f. डा, Bengal madder, Rubia manjith.
 --Comp.

मुण्डय मुण्डय, a denomin. derived from मुण्ड, Par. To shave, Pañc. 223, 8.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मुण्डित, Shaven, bald, shorn, Pañc. iv. d. 36; 49.
मुण्डिन् मुण्डिन्, i. e. मुण्डय + इन्, m. A barber.
